settings.introTitle: A Beacon of Knowledge in Gampaha District
settings.introLead: Founded in 1938 along Sribhodi Road in Gampaha, Thakshila College stands as a distinguished Buddhist educational sanctuary, nurturing over 2,000 students with wisdom, discipline, and national distinction.
settings.introBody: Located in the heart of Gampaha within Sri Lanka’s Western Province, Thakshila College - Gampaha provides holistic education guided by our timeless motto "Knowledge Gives Discipline". Supported by 95+ dedicated academic staff, modern science and ICT facilities, and proud cultural traditions, the college empowers every student to excel academically, athletically, and morally.

academicSections.title: Junior Secondary Section (Grade 6 – 9)
academicSections.desc: Bilingual and English medium foundation focusing on STEM, languages, aesthetic arts, and character development.

academicSections.title: Senior Secondary – G.C.E. O/L (Grade 10 – 11)
academicSections.desc: Comprehensive preparation for the Ordinary Level examination with modern science laboratories and smart classrooms.

academicSections.title: G.C.E. Advanced Level – Science & Mathematics
academicSections.desc: Combined Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and ICT streams consistently producing top district rankers.

academicSections.title: G.C.E. Advanced Level – Commerce, Arts & Technology
academicSections.desc: Accounting, Business Studies, Economics, Engineering Technology (ET), Bio-Systems Technology (BST), and Humanities.

settings.principalMessageTitle: A Warm Welcome from the Principal’s Desk
settings.principalMessage:
There is a feeling of great pride that Thakshila College is a leading school among the schools located within the Gampaha Municipal limits, and a school that has come forward within a short history.

      Started thirty-five years ago with only three classes, Thakshila College today is a school with six parallel classes each from Grade 6 to Grade 11, and with Science, Mathematics, Commerce and Arts streams for Advanced Level. Classes are also conducted in the English medium in every section, and nearly two thousand four hundred students study here annually.

      It is a great pleasure that the achievements of our children, as the main mixed school in Gampaha town, remain at a high level. Also, the children of Thakshila also contribute to the various occasions of our neighbouring sister schools. Thakshila is blessed with group of children who passes not only academic excellence but also. many extra curricular abilities.

      Within It's short school history, Mother Thakshila has been able to produce a group representing various fields of the country. It is a great honour to the school that children, as old students, continue to keep the school proudly in high place.

      Even though the school is located in a place with limited space and facilities, the school community works to take the school forward, considering it not as an obstacle but as a pride. Serving as a teacher of this school is considered a pride by every teacher. As a result of that spirit in the year 2026, the school was able to win second place in the Advanced Level school's section of the National Productivity Competition.

      Environmentally and in waste management too, Thakshila College provides an example to many institutions. That pride of Thakshila, a school with a high demand among the people of the area, will remain in the future. It is special that the annual commemoration of the school has also been organized for several years as an example to many schools. Making the area around Gampaha a place free of garbage, and helping underprevileged schools are also part of it.

      Best wishes for the proud journey of Thakshila.
settings.historyFounders: Established in 1938 through the noble vision of dedicated Gampaha philanthropists, local community elders, and Buddhist educational pioneers who aspired to bring quality, values-centered secondary education to Gampaha.
settings.historyInitialStudents: Commenced humbly in 1938 with just 45 pioneering students and 3 devoted teachers in a modest learning pavilion.
settings.historyOverview: From its modest beginnings in 1938 with 45 students, Thakshila College blossomed through eras of science expansion, cultural renaissance, and national productivity honours—evolving today into a flagship institution educating over 2,000 students across modern multi-story academic complexes.
settings.historyImageCaption: Preserving Decades of Academic Heritage Since 1938
settings.emblemMeaning: The circular Maroon and Gold crest centers around a blazing traditional Dharma Lamp (Pahana) radiating rays of wisdom across the universe, crowned by the timeless invocation "Be a Lamp Unto the World" (Atta Deepa Viharatha). The outer wheel embodies eternal learning, righteous progress, and collegiate unity.
settings.mottoMeaning: True education transcends textbooks; intellectual enlightenment (Knowledge) naturally cultivates self-restraint, moral uprightness, and principled leadership in society (Discipline).
settings.flagColorsTitle: Maroon & Gold — Symbolism of Flag Colors
settings.flagColorsMeaning: Deep Maroon signifies courage, unwavering determination, resilience, and nobility of heart. Radiant Gold symbolizes pure wisdom, enlightenment, intellectual brilliance, and spiritual purity.
settings.achievementsImageCaption: 2nd Place in National Productivity in Sri Lanka & All-Island Distinction
settings.olDescription: Consistently achieving high O/L qualification rates for Advanced Level studies, with outstanding students securing 9 A-grade distinctions every year across Sinhala and English mediums.
settings.alDescription: Producing top district rankers across Physical Science, Biological Science, Commerce, Technology (ET/BST), and Arts streams—securing admissions to leading state universities.
settings.sportsDescription: All-Island podium triumphs at the National School Games across Track & Field Athletics, Cricket, Volleyball, Swimming, Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess, and National Cadet Corps.

settings.historyIntro: Gampaha Thakshila Vidyalaya, a proud mixed school situated in the heart of Gampaha, has been enlightening the children of the nation and nurturing citizens with personality for over three decades.
settings.historyBeginningText: Gampaha Thakshila Maha Vidyalaya was inaugurated on Monday, 15th July 1992 at 10.14 am at an auspicious moment. By the year 2026, Thakshila Vidyalaya celebrates 35 years of proud history.
settings.firstPrincipalImageCaption: Mrs. Yapa Dissanayake — Founding Principal of Thakshila Vidyalaya (1992 – 2002)
settings.startingStudents: Nearly 60 students in three Grade 6 classes
settings.historyTodayText:
Today, Thakshila is a leading 1AB mixed school in the region, where over 2,000 students study from Grade 6 to Grade 11 and in the Advanced Level streams of Science, Mathematics, Commerce and Arts, in both Sinhala and Bilingual mediums.

Under the leadership of the present Principal, Mr. T. M. Premavansha, and with the guidance of 94 teachers, the school is committed to creating a perfect generation of students, rich in virtues and excellent personality, through a quality teaching–learning process.
settings.historyAcademicText:
For several years, the school has earned a reputation among the leading schools in the Gampaha Zone through the results of the G.C.E. (Ordinary Level) and G.C.E. (Advanced Level) examinations.

Our aim is to produce disciplined, law-abiding citizens who can fearlessly face future challenges through co-curricular and extracurricular activities.
settings.historyAchievementText: Second Place in the Advanced Level Schools category at the National Productivity Awards Competition 2025/26, organized by the National Productivity Secretariat, for building a productivity culture within the school.
settings.historyEnvironmentText:
Though situated on a limited land close to the main city, the school provides excellent facilities including laboratories, computer units, smart classrooms, media unit, sports, aesthetics, home science and subject units.

With proper waste management and a beautifully maintained premises, Thakshila has become a pleasant place for all, supported by its teachers, parents, old students and well-wishers.

Gampaha Thakshila Vidyalaya, with a heritage of 35 years, shines as a proud school.
